maria: Heads-up: ran an on-demand replay for customer-42 to rehydrate late telemetry (2026-03-18 02:00-05:00). ~8% of shards hit `503 capacity_exhausted`. I clicked the Console 'Retry' on the failed shards and the UI shows quota consumed twice. Did we change retry billing semantics?

ashwin: We didn't intentionally change anything. Which backend path did Console call for Retry — the inline-resume or the 'create new replay' endpoint?

maria: Looks like Console is calling the create endpoint. Traces show `route_policy=best_effort` and `retry_attempt=1`. Billing logs show tokens deducted at job creation and again at consumption.

jordan: If Console creates a new replay job that's expected (we bill on create). If it resumed an existing job and replayed only missing segments we should only bill for newly consumed tokens. Need the exact API payload.

sara: UX problem: users assume Retry = restart the same job. We should clarify in the UI. Maybe a short inline warning: 'Retry will create a new job and consume quota' or provide inline resume option.

kevin: Strong +1 on showing estimated extra tokens/cost before they confirm. We already have an estimator in Optimize — can we call that from Console for a quick estimate?

maria: Found the API response that Console receives:

```
POST /internal/replay
{
  "job_id": "r-2026-03-18-42",
  "billing_mode": "charge_on_create",
  "route_policy": "best_effort"
}
```

So current flow intentionally sets `charge_on_create` to keep job semantics simple/immutable. That explains the double-deduct when users think it's a retry.

ashwin: This is an internal API debate we've had before. `charge_on_create` avoids races where partial checkpoints get replayed twice, but it forces users to pay when they click create. We could add a `charge_on_consume`/`inline_resume` mode that dedups via checkpoint tombstones, but that adds complexity and storage.

jordan: Also routing fallback matters here. When capacity is low we route to `fallback_variant` (smaller quantized model) which changes tokenization and can increase apparent billing. Console should indicate 'this Retry may run on fallback model X' so users aren't surprised by cost/quality changes.

maria: Support flagged a customer last night — they clicked Retry, job fell back to quantized variant, and cost/spammy outputs spike. They expected the same model.

sara: Proposal for rollout/UX: In the Replay modal add two options with short descriptions and cost estimate:
- Inline resume: attempt to resume existing job, de-duplicate by checkpoint, may wait until capacity freed, billed only for new tokens.
- Create new replay: spawn new job immediately, billed on create, may route to fallback variants if capacity low.

kevin: Backend work: add `inline_resume=true` flag on `/internal/replay` that toggles billing to `charge_on_consume` and sets resume semantics. We also need to add a short TTL for checkpoint tombstones to avoid unbounded storage.

maria: Quick win we can do today: add a tooltip on the Retry button: `This will create a new replay and consume quota. Click Resume to attempt inline resume (may wait).` I'll open a tiny PR to add the tooltip text so Support has something to point to.

eng-bot: deploybot: prod:console:frontend patch rolled to staging (PR #5421) — tooltip added to staging.

ashwin: Telemetry: let's emit `replay_retry_path` (enum: inline|new_job) and `replay_estimated_extra_cost` so we can measure user choices and cost deltas. Also capture `replay_fallback_variant` when fallback occurs.

jordan: Dashboards: add a Replay Cost delta panel per-customer showing cost before vs after retries and a heatmap of fallback_variant frequency. That will help PM/support prioritize.

maria: I'll write a short RFC outlining the API flag, checkpoint TTL, and Console UX mock (radio with cost estimates). I'll also file a follow-up ticket to surface the estimator in Console.

sara: Great. Can you also ping #support with the temporary tooltip text so they can update KB?

maria: Yep — pinged #support with the note.

sara: :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll add the two metrics to the telemetry schema and a small Grafana panel prototype.

maria: Thanks all — tracking: RFC + PR for tooltip (staging) + telemetry schema change ticket. We'll reconvene after RFC review.
